notes:
Dark appearance is now available throughout the workspace.

- Switch Light / Dark using the radio buttons near the bottom of the left side menu.
- Open Settings below them, or Edit → Preferences, to save your startup default: Light, Dark or Follow Windows.
- Side-menu switches apply to the current session. Reopening uses your saved default.
- Fabric colors, exact quilt geometry and exported output remain unchanged. Drawing paper and print previews stay white.
- Existing installations begin in Light. My Blocks, drawings, fabrics and project compatibility are preserved.

This is an appearance update. Larger layout features remain in development.
